images.title: Excess minus shortfall
images.purpose: Shows 320185 with its digits sorted into excess places and shortfall places: 8 − 11 = −3, so the remainder on division by 11 is 8.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One row of six digit boxes with two sums below it.
images.exact_structure: A row of 6 square boxes spelling 320185, one digit per box. The boxes for 2, 1 and 5 (ten thousands, hundreds, units) are filled light teal (#0072B2); the boxes for 3, 0 and 8 (lakhs, thousands, tens) are filled light amber (#E69F00). Below the row, left: excess 2 + 1 + 5 = 8 in teal (#0072B2) text. Right: shortfall 3 + 0 + 8 = 11 in amber (#E69F00) text. Under both, centred: 8 − 11 = −3, and below it a reddish purple (#CC79A7) rounded tag remainder 8. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: Excess minus shortfall tells how far a number is from a multiple of 11.
